title: Atoms in the Semigroup of Non-Negative Integer Matrices
summary: In the semigroup $M_2(\mathbb{N}_0)^\bullet$, two-by-two matrices with non-negative integer entries and non-zero determinant, we study the factorization of matrices into atoms, or irreducible matrices. In 2022, Baeth et al. listed some fundamental classes of atoms in $M_2(\mathbb{N}_0)^\bullet$; however, the factorability of most matrices in $M_2(\mathbb{N}_0)^\bullet$ remains unknown.
